description: Approved manual spotlight overrides only. Never infer asset permissions from an owner's request. Editorial notes are independently written, not official synopses.

tv.tv-shows-0: A novelist caught between written nightmares and lived horror makes an inviting choice for viewers who love supernatural fiction becoming painfully personal.
tv.tv-shows-1: For anyone drawn to mysterious recordings and stories within stories, its archival premise is an intriguing route into screen-based dread.
tv.tv-shows-2: The gothic family premise makes this an atmospheric choice when you want a horror story about power, history and consequences.
tv.tv-shows-3: A haunted estate and a story reaching across generations give this selection its old-fashioned ghost-story appeal.
tv.tv-shows-4: Period drama and a spreading plague collide in a distinctive blend of royal intrigue and relentless survival horror.
tv.tv-shows-5: An anthology is a great way to sample different strains of horror; this collection brings separate sinister visions together.

indie.indie-movies-0: A nightmare dressed as a children's television programme makes Buddy a striking example of imaginative independent genre filmmaking.
indie.indie-movies-1: The Ugly Stepsister turns familiar fairy-tale imagery into an unsettling look at beauty, pressure and bodily transformation.
indie.indie-movies-2: In a Violent Nature follows its undead killer through the wilderness, giving slasher horror an unusually relentless viewpoint.
indie.indie-movies-3: Rabbit Trap draws on eerie sound recordings and rural folklore, creating dread through atmosphere rather than spectacle.
indie.indie-movies-4: Deadstream twists found-footage horror into a disastrous livestream, balancing haunted-house scares and dark humour.
indie.indie-movies-5: Together takes relationship anxiety into physical horror, using a couple's shared experiences to explore terrifying change.

podcasts.podcasts-0: A folk-horror anthology for listeners who prefer their nightmares rooted in place, history and the things whispered about beneath the surface.
podcasts.podcasts-1: An unusual faith-driven journey provides the sort of immersive world and strange mythology that make audio fiction feel limitless.
podcasts.podcasts-2: Legends and unsettling history take centre stage here, ideal for a late-night listen with the lights turned low.
podcasts.podcasts-3: The boarding-house setting creates an inviting doorway into a larger mystery where seemingly ordinary lives conceal unease.
podcasts.podcasts-4: Surreal storytelling at its most disorienting: this is a pick for anyone who likes horror that refuses to explain itself too easily.
podcasts.podcasts-5: A remote research expedition and an unforgiving environment make isolation part of the fear, even before anything else goes wrong.

games.games-0: Cooperative investigation puts a wonderfully social twist on dread: every sound and uncertain clue has the potential to unsettle the entire team.
games.games-1: For players who want mystery threaded through a nightmare, this blends an investigation with a story about writing and fear.
games.games-2: A deserted spacecraft is a classic survival-horror setting: the promise of isolation makes every corridor feel dangerous.
games.games-3: Psychological horror thrives on uncertainty, and a fogbound town is an especially atmospheric place to lose your bearings.
games.games-4: First-person exploration can make a haunted setting feel disturbingly close; the castle becomes part of the experience.
games.games-5: A hostile journey and the search for answers provide a narrative-led doorway into survival horror.
